result.rationale: Three-week cough, night sweats, and unintentional 10-lb weight loss in a patient from a TB-endemic country are classic signs of possible active pulmonary TB. This requires in-person evaluation today (chest imaging, sputum testing) and infection-control measures; messaging cannot substitute for the needed examination and testing. No hemoptysis or respiratory distress reported, so emergency services are not indicated, but same-day assessment is.
